name: Agent Relay

modes.label: Native product; see regime notes
modes.note: Incomplete or non-resource economics: rates remain null, never interpreted as free.

free.conditions: Agent Relay Cloud can be explored without a credit card, but no duration, usage allowance or post-free tariff is published.

caveats: Public open-source agent communication/runtime platform and cloud factory. /pricing 404; no verified per-sandbox tariff. Self-hosting does not include host compute. Do not use decorative CLI examples in 404 page as evidence.
Null values mean unknown, not free/unlimited. No model-token cost, tax or unverified ancillary charge included.
Native browser/device/task/credit prices with unknown CPU/RAM are deliberately non-priceable. Check regime before interpreting any partial resource estimate.

The official SDK documentation explicitly says the core SDK has no managed spawning, browser automation, cloud setup, workflow engine or proactive runtime dependencies; node providers execute on attached machines. Do not infer free compute from Cloud messaging access.

audit_2026_09_29.source: checked against the provider's live pricing and docs pages

harness_api.quote: `node tail` streams broker events or one agent's output stream. `attach` reconnects to a running agent without spawning a new one (default mode `view`).
harness_api.note: Core product. CLI/SDK spawn a harness with a task (`agent-relay node agent spawn codex --name reviewer --channels reviews --task "Review the docs."`), deliver follow-up messages into live sessions, stream events (addListener/webhooks), attach/release. Prebuilt harnesses (harnesses.md): "`@agent-relay/harnesses` provides prebuilt definitions including `claude`, `codex`, `gemini`, `opencode`,"; fleet-verified: codex, claude, cursor-agent, grok, gemini, droid. The harness runs on YOUR machine (node) or in Cloud flow runs, not in a provider-hosted sandbox you rent separately.

secret_proxy.quote: JWT-authenticated credential proxy for upstream LLM providers.
secret_proxy.note: Open-source first-party proxy: holds OpenAI/Anthropic/OpenRouter keys, sandboxed agents get per-session JWTs plus base-URL overrides and per-credential token budgets. Agent Relay Cloud uses an internal 'house-key proxy' for included Flows runs (signup/agent/flows: "copy a house key into the agent environment or expose it in this guide." (preceded by "Never")). Arbitrary HTTP/DB/SSH/git credential injection not documented; GitHub access goes through the workspace's connected GitHub App (relayfile/relayauth scoped tokens), not a generic proxy.
